_comment: Base props (polish pass): the crafting stations, the Hearth, the claim totem and the storage chest. Static props, no rig; each is fitted to its gameplay box in game (WRCrafting / WRBuilding), so keep the footprints compact.
template: 3d game asset of {p}, single object, entire object visible, centered, three-quarter view from slightly above, studio product shot, isolated on plain white background, soft even lighting, realistic, detailed
negative: person, character, hands, multiple objects, room, interior, floor, ground plane, scenery, cropped, cut off, text, watermark, frame, cartoon, anime, blurry, low poly

creatures.prompt: a rustic wooden survival workbench, thick worn plank top on four sturdy square legs, a wooden vise on one end, a saw and a hammer on top, a lower shelf with planks
a primitive blacksmith forge built of rough stacked stones, waist high, a bed of glowing coals in the top, a small iron anvil on a wooden stump beside it
a medieval armorer's station, a sturdy wooden table with a riveted iron breastplate, tongs, hammers and leather straps, a small anvil on one end
a rustic wooden alchemy table with glass flasks and bottles of coloured liquid, a stone mortar and pestle, a small brass burner and old books
a round fire pit ring made of large rough fieldstones stacked two high, charred split logs inside, unlit, no flames
a tall carved wooden totem post, weathered dark wood carved with stacked animal faces, a carved bird with spread wings on top, set on a small stone base
a sturdy wooden storage chest with dark iron corner bands, iron straps and a heavy iron latch, closed lid, worn planks
